column5: WindowPartitionRuntime owns the stable-sorted row buffer and physical positions consumed by Database::compute_window for ROW_NUMBER with fresh construction at every partition boundary. Go partial-state allocation, SlidingWindowAggFunc hooks, chunk append, and executor memory tracking remain open.

One WindowPartitionRuntime co-owns the row buffer and peer starts, peer ends, and dense ordinals used for live RANK and DENSE_RANK. Go typed chunk comparer breadth, chunk.Row buffering, unsafe-size and update memory deltas, builder construction, and chunk append remain open.

PERCENT_RANK derives from the canonical partition peer start and length, including the single-row zero result. Go typed chunk buffering, allocator and update memory accounting, builder construction, and chunk append remain open.

CUME_DIST derives from the canonical partition peer end and length; the integer-key CumeDistState remains only a compatibility facade over PeerGeometry. Go typed chunk buffering, unsafe-size and update memory accounting, builder construction, and chunk append remain open.

Database::compute_window resolves one syntactic integer or Boolean literal and WindowPartitionRuntime applies source quotient and remainder bucket arithmetic directly to its physical positions, including NULL as zero, unsigned output, and buckets greater than rows. Go prepared, deferred, and folded Constant arguments, builder FieldType plumbing, chunk append, unsafe-size accounting, and executor memory tracking remain open.

The canonical partition buffer and resettable physical cursor select LAG and LEAD source or current-row default handles, including Go wrapping uint64 LEAD addition, lazy defaults, NULL fallback, stable ties, and partition reset. The public LeadLag leaf remains a compatibility test seam. Go prepared and deferred Constant offsets, typed valueEvaluator specializations, chunk.Row byte parity, builder dispatch, chunk append, and executor memory tracking remain open.
